standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: Me? I am the Archpriest who was responsible for the running of this place! I am impressed that you managed to reach my resting place on the lowest level.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Well it wasn't easy for sure. You wouldn't believe how difficult it was to overcome some of those traps.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: The intention was that they should've been impossible to pass. I should know. After all, it was I who was responsible for overseeing the safeguarding of this place.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Why did you need the safeguards? Surely they made it more difficult to do your work down here?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: I'm not sure if I should say... I wouldn't want to compromise the trust that the Justiciar of the Unicorn has in me. Afterall, we did what we did for the safety of Hallowvale.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: So... about that. Hallowvale no longer exists. The Hallowed Sepulchre is now beneath the vampyre capital of Darkmeyer within the lands of Morytania.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: I see... So we lost then? In that case, I suppose it doesn't hurt to tell you after all.
One day the justiciar sent word to me that I should begin work on securing the Sepulchre. He feared an invasion from the followers of the Dark Lord.

Yes, I do. The justiciar said he was going to confront these forces but that I should stay to protect the secrets within this place. I wish I could have joined him on the battlefield. I carried out my duties though.
I never told the others what was really happening. Day by day we worked our way down to the final floor.
As we progressed further, we became more experienced at creating the traps. Each one was more deadly than the last.
Eventually, when our work was done, I performed the last rites for each of my followers and sealed them within the coffins on the final floor.
Finally, I did the same for myself. The knowledge of how to disarm the traps died with us.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: You buried yourselves alive? That's... horrible!

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: No, I think at that point most of us were already dead. We died knowing that we sacrificed ourselves for the good of holy Saradomin and the justiciars who follow him.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Well, at the very least you succeeded at keeping the vampyres out of the Sepulchre. From what I have seen, none of them have been able to enter.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: I am glad adventurer. Perhaps that information will allow my spirit to pass on peacefully soon.

upon-opening-the-grand-hallowed-coffin-i.npc: What are you doing in my coffin? Leave this holy place at once!

upon-using-a-ring-of-endurance-on-the-ar.text: If the ring of endurance is uncharged:

steps.text: You show the Archpriest the Ring of endurance (uncharged).

upon-using-a-ring-of-endurance-on-the-ar.text: If the ring of endurance is charged:

steps.text: You show the Archpriest the Ring of endurance.

upon-using-a-ring-of-endurance-on-the-ar.npc: That... That's my ring! I thought I destroyed it!

upon-using-a-ring-of-endurance-on-the-ar.player: Oh, it's your ring? I didn't know.

upon-using-a-ring-of-endurance-on-the-ar.npc: The Justiciar of the Unicorn bestowed it upon me to help with my work within this place.
I had to work for many hours each day to ensure that everything ran smoothly. As I got older, I found it more and more difficult.
This ring allowed me to continue my work without feeling the effects that aging was having on my body. I suppose I have no use for it now. I guess you can keep it.

upon-using-a-ring-of-endurance-on-the-ar.player: Why did you try to destroy it?

upon-using-a-ring-of-endurance-on-the-ar.npc: When I got word that we had to protect this place from the Zamorakian invaders, I was worried that the ring would fall into the wrong hands.
You don't seem to be too bad though. I hope you put the ring to good use!
